source_evidence.title: KG-GPT: A General Framework for Reasoning on Knowledge Graphs Using Large Language Models
source_evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/181_KG-GPT A General Framework for Reasoning on Knowledge Graphs Using Large Language Models.pdf
source_evidence.text:
Abstract
While large language models (LLMs) have
made considerable advancements in under-
standing and generating unstructured text, their
application in structured data remains underex-
plored. Particularly, using LLMs for complex
reasoning tasks on knowledge graphs (KGs)
remains largely untouched. To address this,
we propose KG-GPT, a multi-purpose frame-
work leveraging LLMs for tasks employing
KGs. KG-GPT comprises three steps: Sentence
Segmentation, Graph Retrieval, and Inference,
each aimed at partitioning sentences, retriev-
ing relevant graph components, and deriving
logical conclusions, respectively. We evalu-
ate KG-GPT using KG-based fact verification
and KGQA benchmarks, with the model show-
ing competitive and robust performance, even
outperforming several fully-supervised models.
Our work, therefore, marks a significant step
in unifying structured and unstructured data
processing within the realm of LLMs.1
1

source_evidence.title: Reasoning on Graphs: Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning
source_evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/191_Reasoning on Graphs Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning.pdf
source_evidence.text:
ABSTRACT
Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning abili-
ties in complex tasks. However, they lack up-to-date knowledge and experience
hallucinations during reasoning, which can lead to incorrect reasoning processes
and diminish their performance and trustworthiness. Knowledge graphs (KGs),
which capture vast amounts of facts in a structured format, offer a reliable source
of knowledge for reasoning. Nevertheless, existing KG-based LLM reasoning
methods only treat KGs as factual knowledge bases and overlook the importance
of their structural information for reasoning. In this paper, we propose a novel
method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs with KGs to
enable faithful and interpretable reasoning. Specifically, we present a planning-
retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first generates relation paths grounded
by KGs as faithful plans. These plans are then used to retrieve valid reasoning
paths from the KGs for LLMs to conduct faithful reasoning. Furthermore, RoG
not only distills knowledge from KGs to improve the reasoning ability of LLMs
through training but also allows seamless integration with any arbitrary LLMs dur-
ing inference. Extensive experiments on two benchmark KGQA datasets demon-
strate that RoG achieves state-of-the-art performance on KG reasoning tasks and
generates faithful and interpretable reasoning results1.
1

relation_review.evidence: 必须覆盖全部必要事实并引用每篇所需原文
relation_review.semantics: 逐项检查关系方向、实体角色、任务/实验条件
relation_review.synthesis: 区分原文直接关系与跨来源分析，不将分析链冒充已入图事实
relation_review.uncertainty: 缺任何必要环节须部分回答/说明缺口，不补写关系

scoring_rules.primary: All required source papers retained; measured using inherited references only after assembly.
secondary: MRR@40: reciprocal first rank containing any known supporting unit
scoring_rules.denominator: 16 failure-selected cross-text cases; before/after paired evidence replay. Not comparable to full v2 averages.
scoring_rules.relevance: 仅原文核查后的有限支持池；没有穷举所有等价来源，池外不等于不相关。
scoring_rules.latency: Evidence assembly only, excluding retrieval, reranking and generation. Historical timings are separate.
scoring_rules.p95: 按各类别及全部可回答题分别计算，单次小样本不表示 SLA。
scoring_rules.answer_review: No new answers generated. No answer accuracy or citation success change is claimed.
scoring_rules.relation_gold: reasoning_chain 为人工可审阅的分析提纲，不是生产图路径金标；共享基准、分析比较不自动对应图谱 Schema 边。
scoring_rules.interpretation: 分别报告基础、跨文本、反例表现；新旧题集分布不同，不能由总分变化推导系统改善或 Graph 胜出。

evaluation_config.planned_output: 固定旧候选的证据选择回放；不生成新回答。

controls.query_vectors: one batched cloud call, reused unchanged across paired arms
controls.order: odd numbered case Hybrid first, even Graph first; one warmup; no response retries
controls.generation_policy: 基础 8 题仅检索；24 道关系题与 8 道反例按证据门控生成，最多 64 次配对生成调用。

comparison.changed: question-driven source recognition and evidence reservation
comparison.generation: No generation replayed; parent answers remain historical context only.

result_display.location: 本题关联的 Graph-before / Graph-after Experiment runs
fields: 历史回答、引用、Token 与 Trace（明确为父运行）
result_display.semantic_review: 自动覆盖分数不是答案正确性；语义判读单独标注。

metadata.review_origin: Codex delegated source review; not independent human scoring
metadata.content_scope: 逐题参考事实、原文证据和位置、关系判读、评分与运行配置；实际结果关联 Experiment。
